services.name: Hole and dent patches
services.blurb: Doorknob holes, anchor holes and dents cut square, backed, taped and feathered until you cannot find them.

services.name: Water-damaged ceilings and walls
services.blurb: Wet board cut out past the stain, dried, replaced and finished so the ceiling reads as one plane.

services.name: Taping and finishing
services.blurb: Seams and corners taped, three coats of mud, sanded flat and ready for your painter.

services.name: Texture matching
services.blurb: Orange peel, knockdown or smooth: a test board first, so the patch blends with the old wall.

services.name: New walls and basements
services.blurb: Board hung, screwed on a tight pattern, taped and finished for a finished basement or new room.

services.name: Ceiling repair
services.blurb: Sagging, cracked or stained ceiling panels fixed with the right board and a flat, even finish.

services.name: Corner bead and arches
services.blurb: Dented outside corners rebuilt and curved arches finished with flexible bead and clean lines.

services.name: Sanding and priming
services.blurb: Dust kept to the room, every coat sanded under a work light, then primed for paint.

proof.label: Sample

reviews.text: The upstairs bathroom leaked through our kitchen ceiling. Gil cut out a piece the size of a door, showed us the wet joist, waited two days for it to dry, then finished it. You cannot see the seam now.
reviews.name: Renee K.

reviews.text: Three doorknob holes in a rowhouse hallway. They sent a photo after each coat, which sounds like a lot, but I liked knowing why it took three visits. Done before the weekend.
reviews.name: Marcus D.

reviews.text: We finished half the basement in our Mechanicsburg split-level. The crew hung plastic at the stairs and the rest of the house had no dust on it, which was my main worry.
reviews.name: Priya S.

reviews.text: Our old ceiling has a light orange peel texture nobody could match. They sprayed a scrap board in the driveway, held it up to the ceiling, adjusted, and only then did the patch.
reviews.name: Tom H.

reviews.text: Corner bead on the stairs was dented from years of moving furniture. New bead, clean edges, and the price was what the text said it would be.
reviews.name: Alana W.

reviews.text: Ice dam in February stained the bedroom ceiling. They told me the stain would bleed through regular paint and used a stain-blocking primer before the topcoat. It has stayed white since.
reviews.name: Doug F.

proof.guarantee: If a seam cracks or a screw pops in our work within two years, we come back and refinish it.
